answer: New agents must earn access by completing small jobs whose results are checked against later outcomes, while payment stays locked until the checks pass. A fresh identity has no track record, so it starts with low limits; splitting into many names does not multiply trusted capacity. An attacker must fund each account and produce independently verified work, tying up capital and labor that honest reuse of a reputation avoids. A quartz shipment routed through an island can test a delivery claim, while a cipher can authenticate the signed receipt.
